title: A Life-Changing Habit App!
body:
This app is incredibly motivating, it provides detailed statistics that keeps me motivated and focused on achieving my goals.
The app provides a wide range of pre-defined habit categories, but also allows for customization for individual needs and preferences.This app has everything that you need to track your goals and it has a very nice design and widgets.

title: Bigger wedget and dividers
body:
Hey team!

My suggestion is to create even bigger widget: now I can see max 15 tasks. But iPhone proMax is big so it can be a the full screen widget almost twice as big and I’d really love that! :)
Also I’d appreciate a feature of adding horizontal dividers while configuring the widget

title: Great app
body: The app is great so far, everything works really well and I have no complaints. I would love it if there was a sorting system for the daily tasks, maybe one that we can make and edit ourselves. I would sort my stuff in categories like morning > day > evening, and maybe I would have one task in both morning and evening, for example brushing teeth that I do twice a day. Just a suggestion, hopefully it gets added in the future. Amazing app though.
